process.title: Welding, Eyelets and Installation

faq.a: By square metre, the banner weight (440 g / 510 g / mesh / fabric), the finishing such as eyelets and welding, the quantity, and whether installation is needed. Send us the dimensions and where it will hang and we will quote the same day.

faq.q: What is the largest banner you can print?
faq.a: Our presses print 320 cm wide in one piece, with no limit on length. For wider façades the panels are heat-welded together and the seam is not visible.

faq.q: What is the difference between mesh and banner?
faq.a: Banner is opaque and blocks the view completely. Mesh is perforated and lets wind through, which makes it safer on scaffolding, tall façades and exposed sports grounds.

faq.q: How quickly can a banner be ready?
faq.a: Standard work is delivered within 1–3 working days of artwork approval. Urgent jobs can be produced the same day.

faq.q: How long does a banner last outdoors?
faq.a: Good PVC banner with solvent printing holds its colour outdoors for two to three years. Mesh, and any façade in constant direct sun, has a somewhat shorter life.
Yes. Across Istanbul our own team installs façade banners, mesh and hanging banners, arranging scaffolding or a crane where needed. Elsewhere we ship the banner eyeletted and ready to hang.

faq.q: Do you produce in bulk for retail chains?
faq.a: Yes. We print the same campaign artwork at the right size for dozens of branches and pack it branch by branch for delivery.

fiyatFaktorleri.aciklama: 440 g standard banner, 510 g heavy banner, blackout banner, perforated mesh or fabric. Where and how long it will be used decides the material.
Pricing is per square metre. We print up to 320 cm in a single piece; wider work is joined by heat welding.
Edge welding and eyelets are standard. Pole pockets, rope channels, batten slots and special stitching are planned separately.
The unit price falls when the same artwork is produced for many branches. For chain campaigns we handle distribution as well.
Façade height, the need for scaffolding or a crane, and the tensioning structure determine the installation cost. Across Istanbul our own team does the work.
1–3 working days as standard. Same-day production with next-day installation is planned and quoted separately.

bolge.baslik: From Pendik Across Istanbul and Beyond
bolge.metin: Our facility is in Pendik, on the Asian side of Istanbul. For façade and retail work across the city we handle the survey, the printing and the installation ourselves. To the European side and the rest of Turkey we ship rolled banners by courier or our own vehicle — our projects in İzmir and Bursa were delivered this way.
